comparison_scope.configuration: Trixie AMD64, VS, no VPP, Python 3, default YANG
comparison_scope.configuration_reporting: Configuration metadata is reported without asserting option or platform equivalence. A targeted Bazel 8.5.1 config diff confirmed the observed test-trimming partition before removing the former single-configuration guard.
comparison_scope.evidence_limit: aquery establishes configured action reachability, not whether each compiler action executed in the latest build
excluded_from_component_coverage: CppCompile actions owned by external dependency labels
component CppCompile actions in execution configurations (reported separately)
VPP-only translation units and the Python 2 wrapper, absent from this Make reference
SAI/meta/saimetadatatest.c, generated but not compiled by this Make reference
comparison_scope.source_ownership: Every reviewed main non-exec label/source pair must occur exactly once; the 358-source union and provenance checks remain independent.

make_input_drift_guard.hash_basis: Raw index-blob and working-tree file bytes for paths tracked by the main repository index.
make_input_drift_guard.refresh_policy: CI never refreshes this manifest. Review Make source ownership and regenerate the measured source inventory before accepting changed guarded inputs.

ownership_review.method: Derived the candidate from saved valid main non-exec aquery rows, then checked each pair against current cc_* srcs declarations, default source branches, generated-label mappings, and corresponding Make source variables.

notes.detail: Make lists SaiDump.cpp in both saidump_SOURCES and libsaidump_a_SOURCES. The accepted Bazel ownership compiles it once in libsaidump; BUILD review establishes that saidump directly depends on :libsaidump. This aquery parser has compile-owner rows, not target dependency-edge evidence, so it does not independently prove that closure edge.
notes.label: //saidump:saidump

notes.detail: Make repeats VidManager.cpp in libSyncd_a_SOURCES. The contract requires one compile action for this label/source pair.
notes.label: //syncd:libsyncd

ownership_review.pairs_encoding: Compact UTF-8 JSON of sorted [label, normalized_source] arrays with ensure_ascii=true, comma/colon separators, and no trailing newline.
